proof_summary: Take the explicit case \(p=7\), \(r=6\). A direct \(7\)-adic summation of the binomial terms, tracking their valuations and unit parts modulo \(7^{25}\), gives residues \(821327337676838434975\) and \(1012908569057404849376\); their difference is exactly \(191581231380566414401=7^{24}\), so they are not congruent modulo \(7^{25}\).
